channel.title: Small Business Deadline Calendar: vendor changes
channel.description: Dated vendor and system changes small businesses should check, each with its official source. General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Oct 16: Old Microsoft Whiteboards still in Azure are deleted
item.description:
Date: Oct 16, 2026
Who: Work or school accounts with Whiteboards not migrated to OneDrive
What to check: Check the 'Not migrated' section in Whiteboard and export what you need.
Official source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/whiteboard/migration-of-whiteboards-from-azure-to-onedrive

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 1: IRS FIRE: last day for test files
item.description:
Date: Nov 1, 2026
Who: Businesses that e-file 1099s themselves through FIRE
What to check: Check who files your 1099s and which system they use.
Official source: https://www.irs.gov/e-file-providers/filing-information-returns-electronically-fire

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 2: Amazon commercial liability insurance changes start
item.description:
Date: Nov 2, 2026
Who: Amazon sellers in categories with enhanced safety listing requirements; sellers based in Mainland China
What to check: Check whether your category is covered and whether your policy is on file with Amazon.
Official source: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/seller-forums/discussions/t/287d5c33-8278-4802-ba69-2f58f7dda408

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 3: ZenBusiness Banking: deposits stop
item.description:
Date: Nov 3, 2026
Who: ZenBusiness Banking account holders
What to check: Check everything that pays into the account and send new bank details.
Official source: https://help.zenbusiness.com/zenbusiness-banking/banking-closure-faq

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 9: IRS FIRE: last day to change IR Applications for TCC
item.description:
Date: Nov 9, 2026
Who: Businesses that file through FIRE
What to check: Check whether an IRIS Application for TCC is started (the IRS says current FIRE users must complete a separate IRIS Application for TCC).
Official source: https://www.irs.gov/e-file-providers/filing-information-returns-electronically-fire

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 19: IRS FIRE: last day to file information returns (3 p.m. ET)
item.description:
Date: Nov 19, 2026
Who: Businesses that file 1099s through FIRE
What to check: Check for open corrections or late returns and ask your provider if they are on IRIS.
Official source: https://www.irs.gov/e-file-providers/filing-information-returns-electronically-fire · https://www.irs.gov/filing/e-file-information-returns-with-iris

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.

item.title: Nov 30: ZenBusiness Banking: accounts close
item.description:
Date: Nov 30, 2026
Who: ZenBusiness Banking account holders
What to check: Check balance moved, payments switched, debit card charges moved, mailing address current.
Official source: https://help.zenbusiness.com/zenbusiness-banking/banking-closure-faq · https://help.zenbusiness.com/zenbusiness-banking/move-your-money-from-zenbusiness-banking

General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice.
